title: Quadratic Functions and Equations | Algebra I, Unit 9 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Graph parabolas and find the vertex, use vertex form and transformations, then solve quadratic equations by graphing, square roots, factoring, completing the square and the quadratic formula. Use the discriminant to count solutions, and model with quadratics. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
